## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check . && ruff format --check .` passes
- [ ] `mypy src/toolwall` passes
- [ ] `pytest -q` passes locally
- [ ] Commits are signed (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated if the change is user-facing
- [ ] New public symbols have at least one test
- [ ] New attack patterns ship with a positive and a negative test
